# Amaana Foundation

> Amaana Foundation is a charitable foundation based in Hyderabad, India. This index points to the Foundation's public information, programmes, verification process and donation policies.

## Foundation and accountability

- [About Amaana](https://amaanafoundation.org/about): The Foundation's background and approach.
- [Our work](https://amaanafoundation.org/our-work): Published programmes and initiatives.
- [Impact](https://amaanafoundation.org/impact): Reported outcomes and programme history.
- [How we verify](https://amaanafoundation.org/how-we-verify): Assistance verification and publication safeguards.
- [Transparency](https://amaanafoundation.org/transparency): Public accountability information.
- [Governance](https://amaanafoundation.org/governance): Governance and oversight.
- [Compliance](https://amaanafoundation.org/compliance): Current donation and registration disclosures.

## Giving and participation

- [Appeals](https://amaanafoundation.org/appeals): Currently published appeals and their status.
- [Donate](https://amaanafoundation.org/donate): Supported domestic giving routes.
- [Donation policy](https://amaanafoundation.org/donation-policy): Donation terms and handling.
- [Refund policy](https://amaanafoundation.org/refund-policy): Refund rules and procedures.
- [Get involved](https://amaanafoundation.org/get-involved): Ways to participate in the Foundation's work.
- [Contact](https://amaanafoundation.org/contact): Official contact channels.

## Privacy and scope

- [Privacy policy](https://amaanafoundation.org/privacy): Personal-data and privacy information.
- [Terms](https://amaanafoundation.org/terms): Website terms.

Amaana Foundation accepts donations from domestic Indian sources only and is not presently FCRA-registered. Its Section 12A and Section 80G approvals are provisional. The platform currently issues normal donation acknowledgements, not Section 80G tax-deduction certificates. Consult the compliance page for current disclosures; do not infer tax eligibility from a donation acknowledgement.

Use the linked public pages for current facts and appeal availability. This index does not include private assistance records, donor records, administrative routes or receipt links. Respect the site's robots.txt and publication safeguards.
